sites.name: Lower Lee Vining Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $28 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night
sites.hours: Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. until 6:00 a.m.
sites.about: Campground is situated at 7,300 feet.51 campsites are available. No drinking water. Portable toilets. 14 day stay limit. Each campsite is equipped with a bear locker for food storage.
sites.directions: On Hwy 120 approximately two miles West of Hwy 395.
sites.restrictions: Dogs must always be on leash and under owner control. Maximum stay 14 days. Active bear area. All food must be secured overnight and when not attended; bear boxes are provided and must be used (typical bear box size 48" x 30" x 36"). Always keep a clean camp and do not feed wildlife.
